targets.rawSql: SELECT "DB_ID" AS id, "NAME" AS database, COALESCE("DB_LOCATION_URI", '') AS location FROM "DBS" ORDER BY "NAME";

SELECT d."NAME" AS database, t."TBL_NAME" AS table_name, t."TBL_TYPE" AS table_type, COALESCE(s."LOCATION", '') AS location FROM "TBLS" t JOIN "DBS" d ON d."DB_ID" = t."DB_ID" LEFT JOIN "SDS" s ON s."SD_ID" = t."SD_ID" ORDER BY d."NAME", t."TBL_NAME";
